current.text: He is a rookie and is out after another knee surgery. Yahoo lists him as out (knee).
The early recovery timetable was about six months. The Spurs have not ruled him out for the season.
He could play at some point this season, but that is uncertain.
The Spurs are very deep at forward. They drafted three centers and brought in younger backup centers.
He sits behind Victor Wembanyama. Becoming a starter will take time.
He is not a draft target in our league. His projected line has almost no value, even when he plays.

durable.text: He has had repeated knee surgeries.
His knee carries ongoing risk. He may need more surgery.
He is very young. He is a strong shot blocker who runs the rim.
His free throw shooting is very poor.
If he stays healthy, he is projected to become a dominant defensive player.
